research_story.counterexample: Transferring the full BA cameras improved pose but failed the Room held-out PSNR gate because BA also moved camera centers under a pure-rotation intervention.
research_story.problem: A registered 1-degree training-camera rotation perturbation materially reduced held-out 3DGS quality; photometric pose optimization did not meet the recovery contract.
research_story.targeted_fix: Transfer only the standard-BA OpenCV c2w rotations while retaining each perturbed-input world-space camera center; keep cameras fixed for all 7k steps.
